test_name: Verify User Login via GitHub OAuth
description: This test validates that the user can log in using GitHub OAuth and access the dashboard without errors.
steps: Locate the GitHub login button using its stable selector.
Verify redirection to the GitHub OAuth authentication page.
Click the 'Sign In' button on the GitHub authentication page.
Verify that the user is on the dashboard and logged in.
expected_results: User is redirected to the GitHub OAuth page.
User can authenticate using valid GitHub credentials.
User is redirected back to https://dev.roost.ai.
User is logged into their dashboard successfully.
edge_cases: GitHub OAuth page fails to load.
User cancels the GitHub OAuth process.
data_requirements: Properly configured redirect URI for https://dev.roost.ai.
Valid client ID for GitHub OAuth.
dependencies: GitHub OAuth service must be operational.
Redirection URI must be configured correctly.
User must have an active GitHub account.
api_interactions: GitHub OAuth API calls for authentication.
Roost backend API to validate authentication tokens.
performance_metrics: Time taken to authenticate and redirect back.
accessibility_requirements: GitHub OAuth page should support screen readers.
Login buttons should have ARIA labels for accessibility.
Ensure keyboard accessibility for all actions.
